# BCQRF

Bayesian Constrained Quantile Regression Forest (BCQRF) for soil property
prediction. This project predicts soil properties (currently clay content)
within an area of interest by combining SSURGO, SOLUS, SoilGrids, and KSSL
data sources, using Monte Carlo simulation of correlated soil properties and
Bayesian updating to constrain quantile regression forest predictions. It
includes a Coweeta Hydrologic Laboratory watershed case study.

## Contents

  - [`_targets.R`](_targets.R): the {targets} pipeline and the project's real,
    working entry point. Reads `config.yml` (area of interest + properties)
    and orchestrates SSURGO download, component-composition simulation,
    depth simulation, and correlated-property simulation.
  - [`code/R`](code/R): production function libraries, sourced by
    `_targets.R` via `tar_source("code/R")`.
  - [`code/notebooks`](code/notebooks): exploratory / method-development R
    Markdown notebooks (distribution fitting, metalog methods, prototype
    driver notebooks). Not run by the pipeline.
  - [`code/coweeta`](code/coweeta): the Coweeta watershed case-study
    sub-project.
  - [`code/scratch`](code/scratch): superseded, one-off, or broken scripts
    kept for historical reference only.
  - [`raw-data`](raw-data): small precomputed inputs (e.g. KSSL correlation
    matrices) read directly by the pipeline.
  - [`reports`](reports): the manuscript compendium (`paper.qmd` and
    templates).
  - [`outputs`](outputs): destination for pipeline-generated outputs.

See [`code/README.md`](code/README.md) for more detail on the `code/`
layout and known open issues (duplicated logic not yet consolidated, files
with unresolved bugs, etc).

## How to run

This project uses the statistical programming language R. To work with it,
install [R](https://cloud.r-project.org/) and optionally
[RStudio Desktop](https://rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download/), then:

- open the `BCQRF.Rproj` file in RStudio
- install the packages used across `_targets.R` and `code/R` (there is no
  lockfile or dependency manifest yet - this is a known gap, see
  `code/README.md`)
- run `targets::tar_make()` to execute the pipeline
